description: Defines the class CvarElementFormControlInput, a custom UI element for handling form inputs linked to console variables (cvars) within the RmlUi framework, including event handling and attribute management.

classes.name: CvarElementFormControlInput
classes.description: A custom Rml::ElementFormControlInput that synchronizes its value with a console variable (cvar) and handles related events.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, updating internal cvar and type states.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of child elements, setting up event listeners.

methods.name: OnChildRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of child elements, removing event listeners.

methods.name: ProcessDefaultAction
methods.description: Processes default actions and triggers event processing.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Handles specific events like show, blur, change, and click, updating cvar values accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateValue
methods.description: Synchronizes the element's displayed value with the cvar value.

methods.name: SetCvarValueAndFlags
methods.description: Sets the cvar value and applies flags, with special handling for range types.
